node.value.dictionary.name: Dictionary
Build a dictionary from Key and value no: Build a dictionary from Key and value nodes, an array of property maps, or an existing dictionary. Duplicate keys are rejected or replaced with the last value.
Reject duplicate keys, or replace with t: Reject duplicate keys, or replace with the last supplied value. Keys are case-sensitive.

node.value.dictionary.description: Build a dictionary from Key-Value arrays or an existing dictionary. Keys are case-sensitive; reject duplicates or replace with the last value.
node.data.keyValue.key.name: Get key from Key-Value
node.data.keyValue.value.name: Get value from Key-Value
node.data.keyValue.key.description: Extract the typed key from exactly one Key-Value entry. Accepts dictionary iteration items. Empty or multiple entries fail.
node.data.keyValue.value.description: Extract the value from exactly one Key-Value entry, preserving nested types and Path metadata. Empty or multiple entries fail.
